shelter_sleep.midnightconfig.title: Shelter Sleep
shelter_sleep.midnightconfig.requireRoof: On: the room needs an intact roof. Off: a missing roof or holes in the roof are ignored (without any roof the room is judged by its walls only, and windows are not tolerated).
shelter_sleep.midnightconfig.requireDoor: On: the room needs at least one door. Off: you can sleep in a room without doors.
shelter_sleep.midnightconfig.minRoomSize: Free blocks inside the room, bed included. A 3x3 floor, 2 blocks high, is 18. Lower it to allow smaller shelters.
shelter_sleep.midnightconfig.maxWindowPe: How much of the walls can be open (windows without glass, gaps) and still count as a closed room.
shelter_sleep.midnightconfig.maxRoofHole: How much of the room can be without a roof (skylights). 0 means any hole in the roof shows 'I need a roof'.
